# TPC-DS-OBT Q89

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT * FROM (SELECT obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_class, obt.item_i_brand, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_company_name, obt.sold_date_d_moy, SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(obt.sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_brand, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_company_name) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_year IN (1998) AND ((obt.item_i_category IN ('0', '0', '0') AND obt.item_i_class IN ('0', '0', '0')) OR (obt.item_i_category IN ('0', '0', '0') AND obt.item_i_class IN ('0', '0', '0')))) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_class, obt.item_i_brand, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_company_name, obt.sold_date_d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN (avg_monthly_sales <> 0) THEN (CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0)) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, store_s_store_name LIMIT 100
```
